agent.problem: The only treatment of who sees God's salvation is a false statement saying it will be seen by Zion alone. Marking that false establishes only that the scope is wider than Zion; neither this card nor card 9 tells the central facts that the LORD bares His arm in the sight of all nations and that all the ends of the earth will see His salvation (Isaiah 52:10).

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
